title: 5x5 Cost-based
description: Likelihood is derived from cost-based attack feasibility thresholds; impact is the maximum CIA/Safety dimension.

levels.label: Very Low
levels.description: Physical access plus rare expertise needed; mature controls; no known path.

levels.label: Low
levels.description: Local access and specialist skill; controls present; limited public knowledge.

levels.label: Medium
levels.description: Adjacent/local access, moderate skill; partial controls; known technique.

levels.label: High
levels.description: Remote or easy local access, common skill; weak controls; public exploit/tooling.

levels.label: Very High
levels.description: Remote, low skill, scalable; no effective control; trivial or automated.

levels.label: Negligible
levels.description: No safety effect; minor data exposure; self-recovering.

levels.label: Minor
levels.description: Local CIA loss; nuisance; bounded process disturbance.

levels.label: Moderate
levels.description: Process value falsification or downtime; reputational; no safety harm.

levels.label: Major
levels.description: Loss of control/view of overfill protection; potential SIL demotion; multi-site.

levels.label: Severe
levels.description: Safety hazard (overfill, spill); environmental/human harm; fleet-wide.
